ARABIC LANGUAGE — TERMLY EXAM #11 (TERM 2)
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: ARABIC LANGUAGE
TIME ALLOWED: 60 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. How do you read the syllable ثَا? (1 mark)
   A. lu
   B. qaa
   C. sa
   D. thaa

2. What is the name of the Arabic letter غ? (1 mark)
   A. Saad
   B. faa
   C. ghayn
   D. baa

3. What does the mark sukuun (a small circle) show? (1 mark)
   A. The vowel is long
   B. The letter has no vowel
   C. The letter is doubled
   D. The letter is silent and not written

4. What is the name of the Arabic letter ق? (1 mark)
   A. qaaf
   B. Haa
   C. Daad
   D. DHaa

5. How do you read the syllable جَ? (1 mark)
   A. ja
   B. nu
   C. li
   D. muu

6. Which letters do NOT join to the letter after them? (1 mark)
   A. siin and shiin
   B. baa, taa and thaa
   C. miim and nuun
   D. alif, daal, dhaal, raa, zaay and waaw

7. What does the Arabic word سَرِيرٌ (sariir) mean? (1 mark)
   A. book
   B. door
   C. house
   D. bed

8. Which Arabic word means "plate"? (1 mark)
   A. غُرْفَةٌ
   B. مَطْبَخٌ
   C. صَحْنٌ
   D. سِكِّينٌ

9. What is meant by reading pace? (1 mark)
   A. How fast or slow you read
   B. How tidy your writing is
   C. How many books you read
   D. How loud you read

10. Which Arabic word means "Sunday"? (1 mark)
   A. أُسْبُوعٌ
   B. الْأَحَدُ
   C. أَمْسِ
   D. الثُّلَاثَاءُ

11. What does the Arabic sentence فَوْقَ الطَّاوِلَةِ بَالُونٌ mean? (1 mark)
   A. Above the table there is a balloon.
   B. This is a party.
   C. The friends are at the party.
   D. On the table there is a cake.

12. What does the Arabic sentence الْأَصْدِقَاءُ فِي الْحَفْلَةِ mean? (1 mark)
   A. This is a party.
   B. Above the table there is a balloon.
   C. The friends are at the party.
   D. On the table there is a cake.

13. What are verbal cues? (1 mark)
   A. The size of letters
   B. Intonation, speed and tonal variation
   C. The colour of the page
   D. The number of pages

14. What does the Arabic question mark ؟ tell the reader? (1 mark)
   A. The voice falls
   B. Stop reading
   C. Read very fast
   D. The voice rises at the end

15. How is the Arabic word أَنْفٌ read aloud in English letters? (1 mark)
   A. anf
   B. fam
   C. qalb
   D. ʿayn

16. What does lii ʿaynaani mean? (1 mark)
   A. I have two eyes.
   B. I see with my eye.
   C. My eye is big.
   D. You have two ears.

17. How is the Arabic word مَطَرٌ read aloud in English letters? (1 mark)
   A. matar
   B. shams
   C. nahr
   D. riih

18. How is the Arabic word بِيئَةٌ read aloud in English letters? (1 mark)
   A. ghaa'im
   B. bii'a
   C. zahra
   D. shajara

19. What does al-miftaahu fii l-khizaana mean? (1 mark)
   A. The pen is in the bag.
   B. The chair is at the door.
   C. The lamp is above the table.
   D. The key is in the cupboard.

20. What does the Arabic word حَمَّامٌ (hammaam) mean? (1 mark)
   A. bathroom
   B. chair
   C. cup
   D. spoon

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
21. Translate into English: ash-shamsu fii s-samaa'i wal-ghaymu fii s-samaa'i. (2 marks) (2 marks)

22. Translate into English: uhibbu T-taʿaam (2 marks)

23. Translate: al-qittatu taHta s-sariir. al-misbaahu fawqa t-taawila. (2 marks) (2 marks)

24. Translate into English: fii l-matbakhi taawila wa kursii (2 marks)

25. Translate into English: as-samaku ladhiidh (2 marks)

26. Translate into English: al-asdiqaa'u fii l-hafla. (2 marks) (2 marks)

27. Translate into English: ʿalaa t-taawilati kuub (2 marks)

28. Explain why poems help us when learning a language. (2 marks) (2 marks)

29. Translate into English: fawqa t-taawilati baaluun (2 marks)

30. Name three verbal cues and say how each one helps the listener. (3 marks) (3 marks)

31. Explain what pace is and describe a good pace for reading aloud. (3 marks) (3 marks)

32. Give two reasons why reading is important. (2 marks) (2 marks)

33. Translate into English: azuuru jaddatii yawma l-jumuʿa (2 marks)

34. Translate into English: ash-shamsu fii s-samaa'i (2 marks)
pages.answers:
ARABIC LANGUAGE — TERMLY EXAM #11 (TERM 2) · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. D — thaa
   ثَا is read thaa.

2. C — ghayn
   The letter غ is called ghayn.

3. B — The letter has no vowel
   A sukuun shows that the consonant is read without a vowel.

4. A — qaaf
   The letter ق is called qaaf.

5. A — ja
   جَ is read ja.

6. D — alif, daal, dhaal, raa, zaay and waaw
   These six letters join only to the letter before them.

7. D — bed
   سَرِيرٌ (sariir) means bed.

8. C — صَحْنٌ
   صَحْنٌ (sahn) means plate.

9. A — How fast or slow you read
   Pace is the speed of reading.

10. B — الْأَحَدُ
   الْأَحَدُ (al-ahad) means Sunday.

11. A — Above the table there is a balloon.
   فَوْقَ الطَّاوِلَةِ بَالُونٌ (fawqa t-taawilati baaluun) means: Above the table there is a balloon.

12. C — The friends are at the party.
   الْأَصْدِقَاءُ فِي الْحَفْلَةِ (al-asdiqaa'u fii l-hafla) means: The friends are at the party.

13. B — Intonation, speed and tonal variation
   Verbal cues are the ways the voice shows meaning.

14. D — The voice rises at the end
   A question ends with a rising voice.

15. A — anf
   أَنْفٌ is read anf and means nose.

16. A — I have two eyes.
   lii means I have and ʿaynaani means two eyes.

17. A — matar
   مَطَرٌ is read matar and means rain.

18. B — bii'a
   بِيئَةٌ is read bii'a and means environment.

19. D — The key is in the cupboard.
   miftaah is key and khizaana is cupboard.

20. A — bathroom
   حَمَّامٌ (hammaam) means bathroom.

SECTION B
----
21. (2 marks)
   Answer: The sun is in the sky and the clouds are in the sky.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each half.

22. (2 marks)
   Answer: I like food.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the subject or first part and 1 mark for the rest of the meaning.

23. (2 marks)
   Answer: The cat is under the bed. The lamp is above the table.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each sentence.

24. (2 marks)
   Answer: In the kitchen there is a table and a chair.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the subject or first part and 1 mark for the rest of the meaning.

25. (2 marks)
   Answer: The fish is delicious.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the subject or first part and 1 mark for the rest of the meaning.

26. (2 marks)
   Answer: The friends are at the party.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for 'the friends' and 1 mark for 'at the party'.

27. (2 marks)
   Answer: On the table there is a cup.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the subject or first part and 1 mark for the rest of the meaning.

28. (2 marks)
   Answer: The rhythm and rhyme help us to remember words and to practise pronunciation.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for memory and 1 mark for pronunciation.

29. (2 marks)
   Answer: Above the table there is a balloon.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the subject or first part and 1 mark for the rest of the meaning.

30. (3 marks)
   Answer: Intonation shows questions and statements; speed shows importance or excitement; tonal variation shows feeling.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each cue with its use.

31. (3 marks)
   Answer: Pace is the speed of reading. A good pace is steady, not too fast so that listeners understand, and not so slow that the sentence sounds broken.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the meaning and 2 marks for the description.

32. (2 marks)
   Answer: It helps us to learn new words and information, and it gives us enjoyment.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each sensible reason.

33. (2 marks)
   Answer: I visit my grandmother on Friday.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the subject or first part and 1 mark for the rest of the meaning.

34. (2 marks)
   Answer: The sun is in the sky.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the subject or first part and 1 mark for the rest of the meaning.
